name: momentum_score_composite_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: A composite momentum score aggregating 5 normalized sub-signals — RSI(14), MACD histogram, ROC(10), ADX direction, and volume momentum — into a single -100 to +100 score reduces the noise of any single indicator. Each sub-signal is normalized to [-20, +20] and summed. When the composite score exceeds +60 or falls below -60, all 5 signals agree on strong directional momentum. The edge exists because multi-indicator confluence dramatically reduces false signals. While any single oscillator has a ~50% base rate, requiring agreement across 5 independent signals raises the conditional probability of continuation to ~65%. The inefficiency persists because computing a real-time composite score requires integrating multiple indicators programmatically, which is beyond most retail charting platforms.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 50 crore INR AND close > 100 INR

long.confirmation: composite_score has been > 50 for 3+ consecutive bars (sustained multi-indicator agreement)

short.confirmation: composite_score has been < -50 for 3+ consecutive bars

exit.stop_loss: 0.25% from entry OR composite_score drops below 20 (for longs) / rises above -20 (for shorts)
exit.signal_exit: exit when composite_score crosses zero (momentum consensus lost)

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L; increase to 1.5L if composite_score > 80 (extreme consensus)

filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:45 (indicators need warmup) or after 14:30
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment is built into entry conditions
filters.event_filter: skip on F&O expiry day and RBI policy day
other_filters: at least 4 of 5 sub-scores must be positive (long) or negative (short) — not just sum threshold

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — composite scoring with 5 signals is computationally complex and not easily replicated

weaknesses: 5 indicators means 5 potential sources of overfitting — the normalization and clipping parameters are all tunable
Signal is rare (composite > 60 with all confirmation) — may have 0-1 trades on quiet days
All 5 indicators are lagging — composite agreement means the move is already well underway by entry time
prior_art: Multi-indicator scoring is used in quantitative factor models (Barra, Axioma). Composite momentum scores are discussed in Clenow ('Stocks on the Move') for daily timeframe. The specific 5-indicator combination and normalization scheme here is novel but the concept is standard.
notes: Edge math: 0.55 * 50bps - 0.45 * 33bps = 27.5 - 14.9 = 12.6 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ 1.6 bps per trade. Marginally positive. The strength is in signal quality — few trades but high conviction. With 1 trade/day average: 1.6 bps * 1L = ~16 INR/day = ~4000 INR/year. Not viable as standalone at this capital level. Need to scale capital or use as overlay signal.
